description: Use when you need publicly verifiable random numbers: n integers in [min,max], a pick from choices=a,b,c or a unique draw, derived from a drand (League of Entropy) beacon round with round. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /random, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

choices.description: comma-separated items to pick from instead of min/max (up to 100)

round.description: a drand quicknet round that has already been published; default latest

salt.description: your label mixed into the derivation

name: random
title: Random
